explain.en: Model weights and code downloaded through PyTorch Hub. Programs download them again when needed.
explain.zh: 通过 PyTorch Hub 下载的模型和代码。程序需要时会重新下载。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 169M in hub/checkpoints. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: Programs can also pass their own directory (torch.hub.set_dir, model_dir=); those are invisible from disk.
